the BeatBox server · BeatBox 服务器

在线可分享循环：BeatBox 服务器代码

The server for sharing beats online · 《Head First Java》p575

最终版的服务器监听一个端口，接到每个客户端后开一个线程处理它的消息，并把这些节拍消息转发给其它客户端。下面是其骨架。

import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.util.*;

public class BeatServer {
    private ArrayList<PrintWriter> clientOutputStreams;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new BeatServer().go();
    }

    public void go() {
        clientOutputStreams = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            ServerSocket serverSock = new ServerSocket(5000);
            while (true) {
                Socket clientSocket = serverSock.accept();
                PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(clientSocket.getOutputStream());
                clientOutputStreams.add(writer);

                Thread t = new Thread(new ClientHandler(clientSocket));
                t.start();
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    class ClientHandler implements Runnable {
        BufferedReader reader;
        public ClientHandler(Socket sock) {
            try {
                reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(sock.getInputStream()));
            } catch (IOException e) { e.printStackTrace(); }
        }
        public void run() {
            try {
                while ((null != (line = reader.readLine()))) {
                    tellEveryone(line);
                }
            } catch (IOException e) { e.printStackTrace(); }
        }
    }
    // tellEveryone(): 把这些行发给所有 clientOutputStreams
    //（读者可以补全：遍历列表，writer.println(msg)）
}

↑ 每接到一个客户端，就开一个新线程读它。↑ 每个线程都实现 Runnable、在 run() 里持续 readLine。↑ 收到一行就 broadcast（转发给所有客户端）。
